name: nolte-planning
description: Project-planning cadence for repositories that plan in project/: SMART mission authoring, roadmap init/planning/refinement, roadmap-item decomposition into features, and the sprint lifecycle from planning through execution to review, with the matching readiness, coherence, and consistency reviewers. Adopt this on top of nolte-shared only if your repository runs a mission/roadmap/feature/sprint cadence; repositories that track work as issues never do.
